artworks.title: Acajutla
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a coastline with a rocky cliff extending into the water, leading to an old wooden structure on stilts. The horizon meets a cloudy sky above the ocean, with ships in the distance. The color scheme is sepia, and the water is blurred, contrasting with the rocky texture. Waves are visible near the shore, while ships are stationary against the sky.

artworks.title: Setting out a Coffee Plantation at Antigua de Guatemala
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a hilly landscape. Many men are scattered on the slope engaged in agricultural work on a recently cleared field. The scene is populated with stumps and plant remains. Trees densely populate the distance and reach upwards, indicating a forested area beyond the cleared field. The composition focuses on the slope with clear lines delineating the human figures. The color palette consists of earthy browns and muted tones. A cluster of large, mature trees breaks the skyline in the distance.

artworks.title: Plate Number 521. A: Walking. B: Ascending step. C. Throwing disk. D: Using shovel. E, F. Using pick
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a composite of multiple photographs featuring a full-length male figure in various actions, including stepping up onto blocks, shoveling, and other movements. The individual's face is often turned away, with visible light-colored, curly or wavy hair. The figure is unclothed, and the images are in black and white. The subject is holding a long object, possibly a tool or bat, in some frames. The background is dark with minimal details, emphasizing the figure's movements.

artworks.title: Plate Number 626. Gallop, thoroughbred bay mare, Annie G.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a group of sixteen photographs of a horse in motion, arranged in four horizontal lines of four. The images capture the various stages of a horse galloping. The horse is seen from the side, with each frame showing a different position of the horse's legs and body as it runs. A person is riding the horse, wearing white pants, a black shirt, and a hat. The background is neutral gray. There are black lines between each row of photographs, and each has a small number in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Plate Number 523. A: Striking a blow. B, E: Throwing disk. C, F: Heaving a 75-lb. stone. D: Throwing a ball
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This photograph displays a series of sequential images of a figure involved in an athletic pose with a ball. The grid pattern features rows of small black-and-white photographs capturing different moments in the movement sequence. The images show the figure going through an athletic routine with the ball from various angles. The lighting accentuates the form in motion, emphasizing its fluidity and strength.

artworks.title: Plate Number 340. Boxing, open hand (shoes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a motion sequence capturing a physical interaction between two figures. The image is composed of twelve individual frames arranged in a grid. Each frame depicts a dynamic pose sequence suggesting movement between the two figures. The background features a grid pattern. The figures are positioned in various stances, interacting with each other. The use of a monochromatic palette emphasizes the contours and shadowing, highlighting the progression of frames.

artworks.title: Plate Number 758. Cockatoo flying
artworks.dimensions:
image: 20.3 x 36.8 cm (8 x 14 1/2 in.)
sheet: 48.3 x 61 cm (19 x 24 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a bird in flight captured in multiple stages. The image is divided into a grid of 24 smaller frames, each showing a consecutive moment from the sequence of a bird flapping its wings as it flies. The background of each frame is lined with a grid pattern. The bird's movements are methodically documented from different angles and stages of its flight path, showcasing the mechanics of its wing positions and body orientation as it glides through the air.

artworks.title: Plate Number 469. Child running
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence showing the movement of a figure running. The image is divided into a series of frames capturing progressive moments in the motion of the figure. The background consists of a grid. Each frame captures a static moment, detailing changes in the position and posture. The figure's movement is fluid, with hair and limbs depicted in various stages of running.

artworks.title: Plate Number 733. Elephant walking
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Wall in the Grand Canyon, Colorado River
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a towering rock wall in the Grand Canyon, viewed from close to the Colorado River. The bottom of the image shows the river with a few individuals and a small boat. The horizon is dominated by the cliff face rising up towards the top of the image. The rock layers are visible with striations and crevices. The color palette is brown and gray. In the distance, the rock wall shows layers of geological formations.

artworks.title: Field Where General Reynolds Fell, Gettysburg, July 5, 1863
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned photograph of a battlefield covered with people in dark uniforms lying on the ground in various positions, all appearing lifeless. The ground is covered in straw or dry grass, with a few scattered trees and a slightly blurred horizon in the background. Below the photograph are two lines of text.

artworks.title: Photographische Sternkarten (October 15, 1901)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a star chart. The image shows a grid layout with small black dots spread across the background, representing stars in the celestial coordinate system. The chart, titled "Photographische Sternkarten," was created by Joh. Palisa and Max Wolf and includes annotations detailing its production date, location, and contributors. The chart features references to celestial latitude and longitude, presented on an organized grid with numbered divisions running vertically and horizontally along the edges. These coordinates assist in identifying star positions within the mapped sky section. The information provided emphasizes cartographical efforts to document the night sky in 1901.

artworks.title: Photographische Sternkarten (April 24, 1901)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a star chart. The celestial map is titled "PHOTOGRAPHISCHE STERNKARTEN" and features numerous small black dots across a gray grid on a white background, representing stars or celestial objects. The chart is part of a collection by Joh. Palisa and Max Wolf, produced through rephotography and editing by the authors. The grid coordinates are marked for locating celestial bodies. The photograph was taken using a Bruce telescope on April 24, 1901, showcasing a slice of the night sky for scientific study and navigation.

artworks.title: Photographische Sternkarten (July 6, 1904)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a star chart. The image shows a grid overlay on a section of the night sky, capturing numerous stars of varying sizes and brightness. The star field is densely populated, with some stars appearing as prominent larger dots while others are smaller and less intense. The chart is labeled with coordinates and measurements. The text atop and around the image attributes the work to Joh. Palisa and Max Wolf, indicating their involvement in creating this astronomical map.

artworks.title: Photographische Sternkarten (March 17, 1906)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a star chart. The image displays a grid overlaying a field of stars against a dark background. The chart is titled "Photographische Sternkarten" and is credited to Joh. Palisa and Max Wolf, dated 1906. The stars appear as small dots scattered across the surface, with occasional larger points indicating brighter stars or celestial objects. The framework of the chart is marked with coordinates along the edges. A spherical blur in the upper portion might indicate a lens artifact or a notable celestial feature. The overall appearance is a meticulous and systematic capture typical of an early 20th-century astrological or astronomical study.

artworks.title: Photographische Sternkarten (March 2, 1906)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a vintage star chart created by Johann Palisa and Max Wolf. The chart features a grid layout of black dots representing stars labeled "Photographische Sternkarten". The edges include annotations, coordinates, and numerical markings for rows and columns. This snapshot of the sky was captured through the Bruce telescope in 1902, showing stellar positions calculated for the epoch of 1875.0.

artworks.title: Photographie de la lune a son 1er Quartier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the moon. It shows the moon's surface in black and white, showcasing various craters, marian basins, and textures. The lighting highlights the ruggedness and depth of the lunar surface, creating contrasting shadows and bright areas. The image captures a partially illuminated moon, emphasizing its spherical form. The signature and date at the bottom edge hint towards a specific historical moment.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge stretching into the distance. The horizon is marked by a low hill. The scene is monochromatic with shades of black and gray. The bridge, a small structure, and a river flowing beneath are visible.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view along railroad tracks curving through a forested area. The tracks lead into the distance where they disappear with a slight bend to the right. To the left, there is a sharply angled bank of earth with rough texture and sparse vegetation at the top. The bank displays various earthy tones from dark browns to blacks. In the distance, there is a dense line of tall, slender trees flanking the right side of the tracks, with their trunks creating a natural wall of dark greens and browns. The horizon is obscured by the thick tree line, with the sky appearing pale and fading into a soft, muted cream color. The overall color palette is subdued, consisting of earthy tones and natural hues, typical of a black-and-white or sepia-toned photograph.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a high-angle view of a railway track running diagonally across the left side, with a mound of earth beside it. A small building with a gabled roof is located near the tracks, along with other structures in the background. A body of water with a narrow wooden bridge is visible in the middle distance. Trees, some without leaves, and evergreens are spread throughout the scene. Hills in the distance merge with the horizon, lined with trees. The color scheme is primarily sepia, resembling early photographs. The sky displays scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Casa di Marco Lucrezio, Pompei (House of Marco Lucrezio, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ancient ruin featuring sculptures and stone structures. The image captures a view of an archaeological site with stone pillars, walls, a platform with nude sculptures, small stone statues, and fragments scattered around. In the background, there is a large wall with a textured pattern. The overall tone of the photograph is sepia.

artworks.title: Impronte Umane, Pompei (Human Cast, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure lying on its side in a contorted position with arms and legs extended. The material looks like a rough cast, resembling plaster or concrete, giving the sculpture a texture similar to stone or hardened ash. The color of the sculpture is a pale, dusty gray. The figure is lying on a dusty, earthy surface, and is set against a similarly textured wall in the background.

artworks.title: Impronte Umane, Pompei (Human Cast, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure lying on its side with one arm bent under the head. The figure is detailed with visible features such as a head shape, torso, bent knees, and a foot. The sculpture appears to be made from a light-colored material, which gives it an off-white to grayish appearance. The surface of the sculpture looks rough with visible texture, creating an impression of being aged or eroded. It is placed on a dark cloth or surface with cracked earth or stone tiles beneath. The posture suggests a realistic portrayal of human form and anatomy.

artworks.title: Sunshine and Shadow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dock scene seen from a slightly raised angle, looking along a waterfront filled with moored sailboats. The horizon is unclear, stopping at the dock's end. The boats and rigging are visible against a bright sky. The sails of the closest boat catch the light, contrasting with the darker vessels. The overall color scheme includes soft browns and beiges. In the distance, a pathway on the dock leads towards two human figures, adding depth to the scene.
